children: AUGUST GROUP TRAFFIC: 37.5 MILLION PASSENGERS, UP 0.1%;
PARIS AÉROPORT'S TRAFFIC 10.1 MILLION PASSENGERS, DOWN BY 3.2%
THE GROUP’S TRAFFIC REMAINS AFFECTED BY REDUCTIONS IN FLIGHT SCHEDULES RELATED TO THE CONFLICT IN THE MIDDLE EAST, RISING FUEL PRICES
AS OF THIS PRESS RELEASE, THE GROUP'S TRAFFIC NOW INCLUDES TRAFFIC FROM BHOGAPURAM AIRPORT, INDIA, FOLLOWING ITS OPENING BY GMR AIRPORTS ON AUGUST 17, 2026
